comparator.name: Rechtsgeleerdheid
comparator.sourceNotes: The current official curriculum accounts for 180 EC as three 60-EC years. Year one contains ten 6-EC components spanning legal foundations, criminal law, private law, constitutional and administrative law, rule of law and democracy, international and European law, law and behaviour, legal professions and ethics, persons and family law, and a digitalisation project. The Amsterdam Law Firm 1.1 and 1.2 skills sessions carry no separately stated EC and are not added to the 180-EC reconstruction. Year two contains ten 6-EC components: European Law, property law, legal history, obligations, the Damage and Law project, administrative law, substantive criminal law, administrative procedural law, formal criminal law, and the Sustainability project; Amsterdam Law Firm 2.1 and 2.2 likewise carry no separately stated EC. Year three contains international public law (6), legal philosophy (6), Law and Practice (3), genuine free-choice space (15), civil procedure (6), corporate law (6), one 6-EC integration choice, Fundamental Rights (6), and the bachelor thesis (6). The integration choice is instantiated as Insolvency Law because it is the first official-listed option; Labour Law is an equally valid alternative and this restricted choice is not a formal route. The page says its information applies to the current study year and may change for the next year, so it is not treated as a guaranteed fixed entrant-cohort schedule.

candidates.label: Private law, business and commercial relations

selection.assessment: The closest interdisciplinary law-and-society programme owns the broad direct interests. Two distinct feasible directions deepen the public/international/European and private/commercial sides of the curriculum. Together these reach the three-alternative maximum.

alternatives.label: Law, politics & society
alternatives.labelReason: The completed curriculum contains UCR’s full available law sequence and embeds it in political science, sociology, economics, philosophy, research and communication. The label states the actual interdisciplinary composition and does not imply a Dutch qualifying law degree.
alternatives.concept: The closest feasible UCR response combines broad legal foundations and human rights with criminal, private, constitutional, international and EU law, supported by politics, sociology, economics, ethics, empirical research and persuasive communication. It cannot reproduce UvA's complete Dutch doctrinal and professional-practice sequence.
progression: Law, Society & Justice in semester 1 precedes every advanced law course that formally requires it. Research Methods & Statistics precedes the selected economics courses with that prerequisite. Introductory politics, sociology, economics and ethics precede advanced EU politics, social theory, public economics, conflict study and research. Every course is offered in its assigned term and every formal prerequisite is completed in an earlier semester.

alternatives.label: Public, international & European law
alternatives.labelReason: The curriculum concentrates constitutional and international law, EU law and politics, comparative institutions, conflict, empire and social movements. The label names that public and cross-border focus without implying a complete Dutch-law curriculum.
alternatives.concept: A public and cross-border legal direction connecting constitutional, international and EU law with comparative politics, international relations, EU institutions, conflict, history, sociology, public economics and qualitative research.
alternatives.distinctness: Compared with the closest match, this route removes criminal and private law, political philosophy, ethics, persuasive communication and negotiation. It adds business foundations, modern and imperial history, the history of warfare, international business governance and social-movement study. Six of the 24 courses differ, and the organising emphasis shifts to public institutions, cross-border orders and their historical and social contexts.
progression: Law, Society & Justice precedes constitutional, international and EU law. Comparative politics, international-relations theory, sociology, economics and research methods precede advanced EU politics, conflict, social theory, international governance and historical research. Business Foundations precedes International Business & Governance. Every course is offered in its assigned term and every formal prerequisite is completed in an earlier semester.

alternatives.label: Private law, business & commercial relations
alternatives.labelReason: The curriculum combines private and transnational business law with accounting, finance, economics, strategy, international business, organisational behaviour, negotiation, research and communication. The label reflects those available fields without overstating UCR’s private-law depth.
alternatives.concept: A private and commercial legal direction combining private, international, constitutional and EU law with transnational business law, accounting, finance, economics, strategy, organisational behaviour, negotiation and applied business research.
alternatives.distinctness: Compared with the closest match, this route removes criminal law, political philosophy, comparative politics, international-relations theory, EU politics, conflict studies, qualitative sociology and historical research. It adds business foundations, accounting and finance, digital strategy, organisational psychology, transnational business law, international business governance, econometrics and market research. Eleven courses differ from the closest match and twelve differ from the public/international route.
progression: Law, Society & Justice and Business Foundations establish the legal and commercial strands before advanced private, EU, transnational-business and international-governance courses. Research Methods & Statistics precedes negotiation, public economics, econometrics and market research. The final year concentrates private law, international business, social theory, advanced communication, finance, econometrics and applied research. Every course is offered in its assigned term and every formal prerequisite is completed in an earlier semester.

notes.text: UCR offers a substantial interdisciplinary law curriculum, but not UvA's 180-EC Dutch-law sequence in private, public, criminal and procedural law, its Amsterdam Law Firm skills programme, practice component, integrated projects or Dutch legal bachelor thesis. The pathways must not be read as a Dutch qualifying law degree.
